summary: The diff implements most frontend requirements (REQ-2, REQ-3) and partially implements REQ-1 frontend-side hooks (useUpdatePainting, useDeletePainting, useTogglePaintingSold), but the critical backend file (backend/main.mo) is absent from the diff entirely. REQ-1 requires admin-only backend functions for update, delete, and sold-status toggle in the Motoko actor file, which cannot be verified from the provided changes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend support for updating an existing painting's fields (title, description, price, images, sold status) via an admin-only update function. Ensure delete and sold-status toggle operations are also available as admin-only backend calls. Non-admin callers must be rejected with an authorization error.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff contains no changes to backend/main.mo. All four acceptance criteria (update by ID, delete by ID, toggle sold by ID, non-admin rejection) require backend actor modifications that are not present in the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Mini SOLD stamp overlay on thumbnail images in the AdminPaintingList table and strikethrough title/price for sold rows with dimmed row styling
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requires a clear sold/available status label per row in the AdminPaintingList. The additional thumbnail SOLD stamp and strikethrough title/price in the admin table go beyond the stated requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Disabled ContactEmailCTA with a sold notice banner on PaintingDetailPage
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request does not mention disabling the contact CTA or showing a sold notice banner on the detail page. Requirements only specify a SOLD badge and strikethrough price on the detail page.

hallucinated_features.description: Sold count subtitle in AdminDashboardPage showing number of sold paintings
hallucinated_features.reason: Displaying a sold-count indicator in the admin dashboard subtitle was not requested in any of the three requirements.
